purpose: Teach: 伊勢/明日香/日テレ/タール/プラハ/瀬戸/譚/挿絵

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、伊勢、絶対、旅行、絶対、行ったの?メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — did you actually go to Ise for that trip?
lines.style: Bright curiosity, leaning forward slightly. Open and genuine. Seeking a real answer, not performing the question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お友達の、本気で、絶対、明日香、絶対、ちゃん、絶対、お元気?メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — how's your friend Asuka doing these days?
lines.style: Warm check-in tone. Gentle sincerity underneath. Remembering someone who matters to Aoi without making it a big thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、日テレ、絶対、の、絶対、ドラマ、絶対、見てるの?メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — are you watching that NTV drama right now?
lines.style: Light, conversational. Genuine interest in what she's into. Soft on the question mark, like opening a door to talk about it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、タール、絶対、色、絶対、の、絶対、おしゃれ椅子、絶対、入れたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — I actually went with that tar-colored stylish chair in the end.
lines.style: Animated, a little proud. Quick delivery on the decision. Warmth in showing something she chose. Slight brightness at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、プラハ、絶対、旅行、絶対、行きたいわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — honestly, I'd really love to go to Prague someday.
lines.style: Earnest, a little dreamy. Softens on 'Prague.' The confession of a small, real want. Gentle but sincere.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お祖父ちゃんは、本気で、絶対、瀬戸、絶対、の出身よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — my grandfather is actually from Seto, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant. Saying something she doesn't share often. Tender thread of family memory. Quiet respect in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、好きな漫画、絶対、本気で、絶対、譚、絶対、っていうタイトル、絶対、面白いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — this manga I love has such a great title. It's really something special.
lines.style: Warmth breaking through. Quiet enthusiasm for something she cares about. Slight pause before sharing, like testing if it's safe to reveal.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、メニュー表の、本気で、絶対、挿絵、絶対、お洒落でしょ?メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — the illustrations on our menu are pretty stylish, don't you think?
lines.style: Soft pride in her work environment. Inviting agreement gently. End on a slight upturn, genuine and unhurried.
